units.marketingTitle: A Kitchen Island, Split Bedrooms, and a Balcony to Unwind
units.description:
A private balcony, split-bedroom layout, and two full bathrooms give this River North two-bedroom a strong balance of openness and separation. At Exhibit on Superior, the residence also features a freestanding kitchen island that creates a natural center for cooking, dining, and gathering.
An entry foyer leads to an open living and dining area with room for meals, working from home, and entertaining. The residence includes an in-unit washer and dryer, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, contemporary cabinetry, and plank flooring.
Exhibit’s fifth-floor amenities include an outdoor lap pool, hot tub, sauna, fitness center, and private work rooms. First-floor pet amenities include a dog spa and outdoor dog run. The Superior and Wells location is near CTA Brown, Purple, and Red Line service and the Chicago Riverwalk.
The required $150 monthly Utility and Service Amenity Fee covers heat, air conditioning, water, and natural gas for cooking and the clothes dryer. One-time fees: $500 administrative per apartment and $60 application per applicant. Electricity, cable, and internet are paid separately.
Schedule your tour of apartment 0208 today to see the split-bedroom layout, kitchen island, private balcony, and Exhibit amenities in person.
